seax.name: Seax
seax.description: A long single-edged knife, worn by every free Saxon. Tool, weapon and mark of status at once.

spear.name: Ash spear
spear.description: An iron head on an ash shaft. The common weapon of the levy.

woodaxe.name: Wood axe
woodaxe.description: Meant for timber, not men, but it will serve.

shield.name: Lime-wood shield
shield.description: A round shield of lime-wood boards, hide-faced, with an iron boss.

jerkin.name: Leather jerkin
jerkin.description: Thick hide over quilted wool. Your father wore it on the Danish border.

cloak.name: Wool cloak
cloak.description: A heavy cloak of undyed wool, pinned with a bronze brooch.

brooch.name: Silvered brooch
brooch.description: A disc brooch with a silvered face, taken from the outlaw. Someone will know whose it was.
